notes.title: The Inquisitor - Update 1.1
notes.content:
The Inquisitor - Update 1.1

Inquisitors,

We have just released Update 1.1 on PC (Steam, Microsoft Store and Epic Games Store) and PlayStation 5 that adds new gameplay options to skip puzzles, automate QTE, and more. The Update also addresses various gameplay, general, and visual issues.

Please find the full changelog below.

New Features for Story Lovers: (New Entries in Gameplay Tab of Options) 

 Hide Light Beams: Light Beams can now be disabled via a toggle. General navigation to other districts is still functional. Only none-district gate light beams are disabled. 
 Skippable Puzzles: Puzzles can now be skipped. Once this has been set to “On”, a new input shows up on each puzzle which automatically resolves the puzzle once pressed.
 Easy Combat Mode: Each enemy can be defeated with 1 hit once the toggle is set to “On”.
 Automatic QTE: Once set to “On”, all QTEs automatically complete. 


Fixes:
Gameplay

 Fixed an issue that prevented the Scourge ability to reappear after Mordimer has died in the Unworld.
 Fixed an issue that caused NPCs to get stuck during escorts.
 Fixed an issue that caused Mordimer to glitch through staircases if pushed by an NPC.
 Fixed an issue which prevented the light beam in front of the town hall from getting displayed.
 Fixed an issue which caused the task “Find the warehouse of the brothers Finkelstein” to not get removed from the active task UI.
 Fixed an issue in the cathedral which caused a cutscene to not trigger properly when reaching the related way point.
 Fixed an issue which caused the camera to glitch through the ground while eavesdropping in the Harbor. 
 Fixed an issue which caused unskippable dialogues in the clinic.
 Fixed an issue which caused the Vampire to attack through objects.
 Fixed an issue which caused a boss to move through objects.
 Fixed an issue which prevented shrine interaction while hunting Jonas.
 Fixed an issue which caused the Brood of the Murk to glitch through the stairs at the shards in the Unworld.


General

 Fixed an issue which caused Mordimer to be displayed for a short amount of time after the End Credits.
 Fixed an issue that caused a Monk in the library to be stuck in the ground after finishing his voice line. 
 Fixed an issue which caused an NPC to sink into the ground in the dungeon. 
 Fixed an issue which caused missing subtitles in one of the endings. 
 Fixed an issue which caused Mordimer to disappear when quickly changing graphic settings and going back to the main menu. 
 Fixed an issue which caused the game to become unresponsive when quickly changing the Upscaling options. 
 Fixed an issue which caused the game to become unresponsive when changing the graphical quality in the Unworld. 


Visual

 Fixed an issue which caused Amelia to pop up during the dungeon escape event. 
 Fixed an issue that resulted in the Executioner’s Mask clipping through Mordimer’s hands. 
 Fixed an issue that caused Nontle’s skirt to glitch into the ground. 
 Fixed an issue that caused idling town guards to clip.
 Fixed an issue which caused the merchant son to have blood on himself before the events at the dungeon entrance. 
 Fixed an issue which could corrupt the environment and make it disappear. 
 Fixed an issue which caused a broken environment when loading a save in the Catacombs. 
 Fixed an issue which caused the Ruffian to T-pose inside the brothel. 
 Fixed an issue where a guard’s arm was glitching into his body.
 Fixed an issue which caused Mordimer’s face to get distorted during combat.
 Fixed an issue in the cathedral district which caused a patrolling monk to glitch through another NPC.
 Fixed an issue which cloned the dead body of the vampire. 
 Fixed an issue which caused Mordimer to not properly hold his sword with two hands.


Audio

 Fixed an issue which caused the guards voice over audio to be lower compared to other voice overs.
 Adjusted some volume levels of sound effects.


Achievement

 Fixed an issue which caused the “Master Inquisitor” achievement not properly recognizing unlocked achievements.

notes.title: Out Now! Become The Holy Judge, Jury, and Executioner in The Inquisitor
notes.content:
Journey to Koenigstein today on Steam, PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S 

The Unworld awaits… We have finally lifted the veil between the light and darkness, to bring the dark fantasy game The Inquisitor to Steam, Windows PC (Microsoft Store and Epic Games Store) PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S for £34.99, with the Deluxe Edition containing the Original Soundtrack, Digital Compendium, and The Grandmaster’s Attire for £44.99.

[previewyoutube=i2aygEhJTP8;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1880470/The_Inquisitor/
 
A demo of The Inquisitor is also available on Steam, Windows PC, PlayStation Store and Xbox Series X|S.

The Inquisitor transports players to the year 1500 A.D. in an alternate historical timeline where Jesus escaped his crucifixion and, instead of forgiveness, brought violent vengeance on all the non-believers. In a world full of unrelenting sinners, a trusted servant of Christ Vengeful, Mordimer Madderin, is sent to uncover the sinister secrets and dark forces plaguing the city of Koenigstein. 

In The Inquisitor, players find themselves drawn into a world of deception and conspiracy. Where every gritty twist and turn in the story of Koenigstein, and the story Mordimer himself, unfolds before the player’s eyes. Each player decision will carry consequence and informs the final outcome, offering branching storylines and missions that will test morality and determine the fate of both the sacred and the sinful denizens of Koenigstein.  

With a unique skillset, Mordimer will bring retribution upon the malicious forces that have invaded the city, using his sleuthing abilities to interrogate suspects to mete out judgement in this cruel era of justice. But the mysteries of Koenigstein run far deeper than the faithless transgressions that have befallen the surface. Mordimer will need to descend into the mysterious Unworld ruled by the malevolent Murk, to uncover the mysteries hiding within the souls of the heretics. 

Seek justice today - The Inquisitor is now available on Steam, Windows PC (Microsoft Store and Epic Games Store) PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S for £34.99, with the Deluxe Edition containing the Original Soundtrack, Digital Compendium, and The Grandmaster’s Attire for £44.99.  

Players can also tune in to the Kalypso Media live stream this evening at 6 pm GMT / 7 pm CET where David from Kalypso Media and Piotr from The Dust will play through the first missions together and answer questions from the community. 

Features:

 Be the ultimate Holy Judge and Jury: Your role as an Inquisitor is to maintain order and enforce the faith in God. But the world is full of sinners who have lost their way. Decide the fates of those you judge in multiple story-driven cases and missions. This is a world where morality and what is right have long strayed from each other. So, will you show mercy or undying belief in The Holy Law?  
 A morally tainted, non-linear tale: This is a dark and gritty story centred around a religion preaching revenge and violence. Multiple branching story choices will test your morality. Choose your path and decide what kind of Inquisitor you will be - one of pity or one of retribution - and ultimately what mark you will leave on this world.  
 Enlightened sleuthing: Mordimer has unique skills and abilities that allow him to solve the various crimes and mysteries that have befallen Koenigstein. Track down and interrogate suspects. Discover the hidden truths of the city and its inhabitants. Piece together the evidence and make your final judgments.  
 Delve into the Unworld: Unbeknownst to those around him, Mordimer has the ability to enter the mysterious Unworld. There he can discover the deeper secrets that suspects have tried to hide in their souls. But there is a grave risk when venturing into this world and the dark force which reigns supreme here will do everything it can to destroy you for stepping foot into its realm.  
 Persuasive interrogations: The 1500’s remain a cruel era of justice. As an Inquisitor, you have free rein to use whatever methods and tools deemed necessary to persuade suspects to reveal ‘the truth’. These optional interrogations date back to the times of the real Inquisition and it’s up to you to decide if and how much force to apply to those under your investigation.  
 Let your sword do the talking: Sometimes a tongue just needs to be cut right out in order to loosen it. A full sword-based combat system means various cases will let or even require you to use brute force. Master your blade, find your openings, and use your enemy’s weak points against them.

notes.title: The Inquisitor - FAQ
notes.content:
The Inquisitor - FAQ

What is The Inquisitor?   
In The Inquisitor, players take on the role of Mordimer Madderdin, servant of God and appointed Inquisitor by the Bishop of Hez Hezron. In a world where Christ Merciless descended from the cross to take revenge on his tormentors and triumph over them, it will take more than faith to perform this mighty task. 
You have been sent to the City of Koenigstein to investigate mysterious events and find yourself caught in a fierce power struggle between two prominent local groups.  Throughout your investigations you will encounter dark secrets, cruelty and human sin; and uncover something far darker, threatening, and more dangerous. 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426694/91c85db453a23c5a1476fa2222019ad4722763a1.png

What are the main features of The Inquisitor?   

 Investigation: During the investigation players will gather and analyze evidence and compile all critical information into Mordimers Journal. Players will use those clues to obtain information to gain even more insight and reconstruct crime scenes later in the game.  
 Dialogues: Players will engage in dialogues with citizens of Koenigstein to gather information during the investigations. Decisions made in these conversations will influence the outcome of the player throughout the game.   
 Qualified Interrogations: As an Inquisitor, the player will encounter suspects of heresy, blasphemy, and murder. It is possible to use force and torture to interrogate the suspects to gather information, but those means should be employed with caution – the goal is to save poor souls from damnation￼.  
 The Unworld: Mordimer possesses the power to travel to the Unworld. To enter this abyssal plane, he releases his soul from the body. This ability enables players to see behind the real world and reveal clusters of magic as well as the real nature of the citizens of Koenigstein. But there is a grave risk when venturing into this world and the dark force which reigns supreme here will do everything it can to destroy you for stepping foot into its realm.    
 Combat: Mordimer is not a master of this trade but knows his way around combat quite well and uses his wit to gain strategic advantage over opponents.  

 

Why should I play The Inquisitor?   
You should play The Inquisitor if you enjoy thrilling crime or detective stories and if you like to actively collect hints and clues to reveal secrets that unfold into a mature and rich fantasy adventure. The dark medieval setting, paired with well-placed gore elements, add to the overall grim atmosphere.  

As a player, it depends solely on you how you approach this - will you commit the ‘sin of mercy’ (according to Mordimer's belief, in the alternative version of religious reality) and show compassion to the spiritually weak? Or will you be the merciless hand of God and achieve your goals through torture and intimidation? Depending on your choice, the game world and its characters will adapt accordingly.  

But there’s much more to it – at its core, The Inquisitor is a dark fantasy adventure, which also includes real-time action combat (stand-off encounters and boss fights) as well as The Unworld, a hidden world that comes with its own set of rules. Accessible through a special skill set of the main character, the Unworld allows you to gain insight hidden to everyone else to help you to solve your mission. However, you’ll need to keep the dangers in our world at bay, whilst managing your own capacities as nothing in life comes without a cost.  


On which platforms will The Inquisitor be released?  

The Inquisitor will be released on Windows PC (Steam, EPIC and the Microsoft Store), PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S consoles.   

When will The Inquisitor be released?   
The Inquisitor will be coming February 8th, 2024 for Windows PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S consoles.  
  
Who is the developer of The Inquisitor?   
The Inquisitor is developed by The Dust S.A., located in Breslau (Wroclaw), Poland and is inspired by the bestselling Inquisitor book series by Jacek Piekara.  

Which languages are supported in The Inquisitor?   
The game will support voice overs in English, German, and Polish.   
The interface and subtitles will also be available in French, Spanish, Japanese, Russian, Brazilian-Portuguese, and Simplified Chinese.   

What genre is The Inquisitor?   
The Inquisitor is at its core a story-driven fantasy adventure game with a focus on detective elements, adding action mechanics to the mix.  

What Game Engine is The Inquisitor developed in?   
The game is developed with the Unity Engine.   

Will there be Mod Support in The Inquisitor?   
No, there will be no Mod Support. 

What is included in the Digital Deluxe Edition of The Inquisitor? 
The Digital Deluxe Edition includes one copy of The Inquisitor game, the digital compendium, the original soundtrack, and the awe-inspiring Grandmaster’s Attire. 
Get ready to fulfill your inquisitorial duties to the Holy Office in style and strike fear into the hearts of all sinners within Koenigstein’s borders. 

What are the system requirements for The Inquisitor? 

Minimum System Requirements 
 OS: Windows 10 
 CPU: Intel Core i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 2600 
 RAM: 16GB 
 GPU: GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 590 
 DirectX: Version 11 
 Storage: 23 GB 
 Additional Notes: SSD recommended / Upscaling via FSR recommended 


Recommended System Requirements 
 OS: Windows 10 
 CPU: Intel Core i7-7700K / Ryzen 7 2700 
 RAM: 16GB 
 GPU: GeForce RTX 2070 / AMD RX 5700 
 DirectX: Version 11 
 Storage: 23 GB 
 Additional Notes: SSD recommended / Upscaling via DLSS or FSR recommended

 Let your sword do the talking: Sometimes a tongue just needs to be cut right out in order to loosen it. A full sword-based combat system means various cases will let or even require you to use brute force. Master your blade, find your openings, and use your enemy’s weak points against them.

The Inquisitor's Gameplay Trailer Emerges – Unveiling a Realm of Shadows and Sin

Watch Mordimer’s first steps into gritty Koenigstein and the enigmatic Unworld

In this newest trailer, witness the means at your disposal for righting the sins of Koenigstein. Prepare to put your judgement to the test, the dark fantasy adventure is coming soon on Windows PC, Xbox Series X | S and PlayStation 5. Delve into the abyss and witness the trailer below.

[previewyoutube=h6f1gVjdXD0;full][/previewyoutube]

Prepare to descend into a world shrouded in darkness and malevolence as we have unveiled the latest gameplay trailer for dark fantasy adventure game, The Inquisitor. Emerging from the depths of an alternate religious history, this story-driven epic invites players to navigate a treacherous path through mystery, violence, and sin.

In an alternate 1500 A.D., where a vengeful Jesus broke free from the cross and pursued brutal retribution against the heretics, The Inquisitor thrusts players into a world soaked in blood and shadow. Assuming the mantle of Mordimer Madderdin, a devoted Inquisitor, players embark on a harrowing journey within the corrupt city of Koenigstein. Amidst rampant sin and religious transgressions, your solemn duty as the Inquisitor beckons you to unearth corruption's roots and confront its malicious grip.
Harness the power of strategic investigation as you track down suspects, delve into the intricacies of evidence, and, if necessary, resort to unyielding force. Your role as judge, jury, and executioner hangs in the balance. Will mercy prevail, or shall the sword of retribution fall in the name of Holy Law?
Yet, within the very walls of the city, a deeper darkness festers, a realm shrouded in mystery, the Unworld. Unbeknownst to those around him, Mordimer Madderdin holds the key to unlocking its secrets, peering into the twisted souls of the depraved. The Inquisitor beckons players to unveil its grim truths and confront the ultimate judgment.

notes.title: An Introduction to the Story of The Inquisitor
notes.content:
Dare to delve into the story of The Inquisitor? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426694/b045ea36471af07a0e06482a7f1405a5ace9f764.jpg

We’ll give you a first glimpse at what awaits… 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426694/96e873436cf114618771e4cd7e23d931132765e4.jpg

The year is 1533. Tasked by the Holy Office, the Inquisitor Mordimer Madderdin arrives in Koenigstein, a city bursting with sin, to investigate an alleged vampire hiding there. 

As he seeks information about the bloodsucker, Mordimer becomes entangled in a brutal power struggle between two authorities. As the walls are closing in, Mordimer seeks to solve the mysteries surrounding the strange events in Koenigstein. 
However, the city government reveals no details and only advises the Inquisitor to not trust anyone…

But Mordimer remains determined to track down the vampire and mete out punishment to those he sentences as guilty. With the Lord and a companion on his side, he is not alone…

notes.title: Meet The Inquisitor
notes.content:
Get to know: Mordimer, the main character of The Inquisitor

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426694/a7bf161f479867e7373e39bf891716784f8e8f4b.jpg

It is not without reason that Mordimer was appointed the title of licensed Inquisitor by the Bishop of Hez-Hezron. He is a man of fervent faith and is skilled in both words and weapons. Tracking down anyone who commits sin is his sole purpose as an Inquisitor, and dedicated servant of God. If someone commits a breach of faith against Christ Triumphant, Mordimer must, and will, perform his duties. 

Only he dares to enter the Unworld, to find clues and uncover the truth. But this is only the first step – punishment is needed to keep sin at bay. All the less surprising that witches, sorcerers and heretics no longer feel safe in their dark hideouts when Mordimer arrives. After all, he does not shy away from using torture…

You call it ruthless? Perhaps. But for a true Inquisitor of the Lord, the end always justifies the means.

notes.title: Your assignment awaits here Inquisitor
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426694/6e730aa1b4c7182e2487f3ee7dd72b0e3faeebc8.png

The gritty and rotten-to-the-bone city of Koenigstein welcomes you, Inquisitor. The city is divided into 5 districts, each with its distinctive architecture and folk. Some of these districts will show you the worst you can expect in terms of the inhabitants and living conditions while others will represent the wealthy lifestyle of the royalty.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426694/8a124160bb4f7b0443675a2442ab54a39f4fdeed.gif

Either way, the danger may await at every corner since the corruption and depravation of people living in this city does not recognise class. From filthy thieves through scheming aristocracy, all the way up to the murderous cultists – Koenigstein is a cradle of sin. Be always aware of your surroundings and choose carefully, who you trust.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426694/38a94d4d4b70aecb6fe3fe64f330fecb72047377.png

Your mission in Koenigstein will take you through all the districts and will let you in on the city’s filthiest of secrets. Before you step your foot in Koenigstein make sure you are fully equipped for what lies ahead. Learn this map by heart and use it to your advantage. Be aware, there are hardly any more dangerous places than this one – not in this realm at least.

Stay strong Inquisitors and add the game to your wishlist to stay up to date with the development.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1880470/The_Inquisitor/

notes.title: An inquisitor's best friend
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426694/e479d06dff7cf50f3eb2199d901ef3c307073a3e.png

Even though inquisitors are trained in sword combat, they might not always have equal chances against a bigger group of enemies or even one powerful foe. That’s when shersken becomes a useful ally. Veteran inquisitors like Mordimer Madderdin are well aware of its capabilities and always carry a pouch of shersken attached to their belts or in their pockets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426694/8a124160bb4f7b0443675a2442ab54a39f4fdeed.gif

Shersken can be used in several ways. In small doses, it can heal many different illnesses. When used in large quantities, it becomes a deadly and undetectable poison. It can also be used in combat since when thrown in an opponent’s face, it can blind them for a period of time and cause a great deal of pain. This dirty trick can create an opening for an attack or help the inquisitor to escape from battle unscathed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426694/ef12f2decdee6fd9139493429bec8d2e126a86dd.gif

The origin of this herbal mix is unknown, but it’s believed that the Byzantine Empire originally crafted the recipe. No one knows how and when the Inqusitorium learned how to prepare shersken for its own purpose. The inquisitors need to place an order for each portion and explain how was the previous one used. The place where shersken is prepared remains a mystery.

Keep following “The Inquisitor” on Steam for more fascinating details.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1880470/The_Inquisitor/

notes.title: Did you know? #2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426694/a8874e62d946f2619d54eb0c205cd65936ca41c6.png

Little detail is known about the mysterious Amszilas Monastery. Even the description of this place leaves a lot to the imagination. We can definitely learn from the books by Jacek Piekara that it is a true fortress on a hill covered with foliage and located next to a river bend.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426694/8a124160bb4f7b0443675a2442ab54a39f4fdeed.gif

The monks of the Amszilas Monastery guard a true secret that holds the key to understanding the current state of the world and religion. However, it is not guarded by armed knights or archers. The holy tabernacle is protected by the power of strong faith that the monks carry in their hearts.

The Monastery is also the headquarters of the Holy Office, on behalf of which Mordimer Madderdin conducts his inquisitorial investigations. Demons were also subjected to examination in Amszilas. Sometimes very brutal methods were used for this purpose.

Follow “The Inquisitor” on Steam for more details about the game's world.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1880470/The_Inquisitor/

notes.title: Bringing the world of “The Inquisitor” to life
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426694/521c922d12d94685eeaaf47a72478751a0d533ed.png

Working on “I, the Inquisitor” is a fun experience for our team. Especially when between coding and designing there’s time for some mo-cap sessions. We’ve teamed up with some of the actors from AST in Wroclaw to help us with the character animations and it was a blast.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426694/8a124160bb4f7b0443675a2442ab54a39f4fdeed.gif

We want to achieve the highest level of immersion possible so that the players around the globe can fully appreciate the fantasy world of “The Inquisitor” while stepping into the shoes of Mordimer Madderdin. Motion Capture is just another way of bringing it to life – next to the realistic town of Koenigstein, interesting lore and an engaging story.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426694/0a05279c9542be1741cf97b3848e533385725a13.gif

The sessions included interrogation animation, cut-scenes and, of course, sword fighting. To help us achieve realistic movement we’ve utilised the cutting-edge Xsens MVN Animate system and we can’t wait for you to see the final results in our upcoming devlogs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426694/4e5c55f36a9c7dbdd6eb3f4a87bf2fd4d6a62f3f.gif

Add the game to your wishlist and keep an eye out for more exciting content.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1880470/The_Inquisitor/

notes.title: Did you know?
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426694/ae339a1465d2096b5352c9754d1530efd781ab15.png

Mordimer Madderdin’s past is not very often discussed and little detail is shared on the pages of the books by Jacek Piekara. Until the release of Płomień i krzyż (Fire and cross) the origin of this character was shrouded in mystery. Finally, the author decided to shed some light on Mordimer’s background in the story about Piękna Katarzyna (Beautiful Catherine).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426694/8a124160bb4f7b0443675a2442ab54a39f4fdeed.gif

Beautiful Catherine was a courtesan and an apprentice to an old witch. Apart from conning wealthy noble men into buying her precious gifts, her ultimate goal was to gain access to Sahor Szefer – a book of dark magic. She was ready to do anything to become the most powerful of witches. Even giving away her firstborn.

She never knew exactly what happened when she brought her son to the witch, but she noticed that he has changed. Sometime later, she was captured by the inquisitors, tortured, and burnt at the stake.

Add “The Inquisitor” to your wishlist for more insights into the story of the fantasy world of the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1880470/The_Inquisitor/
